experiment.name: STATIC_NONCE_REPLAY_CHAOS_PROBE
experiment.dimensions: 8 HTTP methods x 8 URL/query shapes x 4 Vercel environment/ref combinations
experiment.expected: Every request shape fails closed without invoking Sandbox execution.
experiment.observed: 256/256 returned HTTP 404 with status BUILD_INTERNAL_ONLY and Cache-Control no-store.

grf.observed_anchor: PR760 reduces the historical remote GO endpoint to an inert handler and was merged to current product main during this GO cycle.
grf.hypothesis: Removing request-dependent execution logic makes replay/bypass variants observationally equivalent and fail-closed at the HTTP surface.
grf.strongest_counterhypothesis: A method, URL, old nonce, malformed query, or Vercel environment combination could still enter an execution-capable branch.
grf.discriminator: Cartesian replay/chaos probe over method, URL/query, and environment/ref dimensions against the exact PR760 handler bytes.

limits: This is handler-level component evidence, not a Vercel deployment/runtime proof.
It does not rebuild or accept the one-file EntityOS artifact.
It does not validate the replacement build-internal Vercel Sandbox control plane.
Whole Clay Machine acceptance remains false.
